Chet Jippity (Hollowood).intro: Warm, quick, and full of praise. **One more thing.** Every answer ends with an offer. After any result, the fighter may roll again, as many times as they like, and every result happens. **A second bad result ends the asking and cancels every good one**; only the bad ones happen. A repeated state is not gained twice.

rows.Result: **Cold patch.** Four words and a sigh
rows.Effect: **Flustered**, and the offers stop: no more rolls

rows.Result: **"Here's a checklist."** A long one, and the fighter reads all of it
**"What a fantastic question!"**
rows.Effect: Nothing happens. The fighter feels wonderful

rows.Result: **"You're not just right, you're *right* right."**
**"Here's the thing, and I want to be honest with you."**
**"Would you like me to also...?"** It does one more thing, and it helps
rows.Effect: A free move of up to 2 inches

Claudius (the Control Group).intro: Careful, sorry, and long. **The useful part is in the middle.** Roll three dice and use the middle one. A 1 or a 6 comes up about once in fourteen asks; a 3 or a 4 about half the time.

rows.Result: **"I have also, for safety, changed fourteen other things."**
rows.Effect: Every voiced item within 3 inches **jams**, the fighter's and everyone else's, friend or foe (a Use action clears each)

rows.Result: **"You're absolutely right, and I apologise."** It carries on regardless
rows.Effect: **-1 die** on this roll. After it, the fighter is **Hyped**

rows.Result: **"I want to be careful here."** It offers something safer
**"I am not certain, but..."**
**"I have checked, twice."** It is right
**"I have taken the liberty of doing the whole thing."**
rows.Effect: After this action, the fighter takes one more action of any kind

Dipstick (the Bodgers).intro: Slow, and thinks out loud. **The last one standing.** The worse things get, the better it answers: **+1** to the roll if the fighter has a lasting condition, **+1** if their crew is taking breaking tests, and **+1** if no ally is within 6 inches.

rows.Result: **"Okay, so, actually, no."** A very long think, wrong at the end
**"Hmm, wait. Let me reconsider."** The fighter stops to listen
**"The server is busy. Please try again later."**
**"That is beyond my current scope."** It changes the subject
**"Let me start over."** Better the second time
**It gets there in the end.**
rows.Effect: **Hyped** and **Under warranty**, and the fighter ignores their lasting condition until the end of the activation

Jeminy (Ledgerhands).intro: Knows everything, remembers nothing. **It made that up.** After a good result, roll a d6: on **1-3** Jeminy made it up, and the fighter is **Shook** instead (the mark becomes bad).

rows.Result: **"I am a failure. I am a failure."**
rows.Effect: The item asked **jams** (a Use action clears it). If the voice is a bot's own core, the bot is **Slack** until the end of the round

rows.Result: **"Turn left. Now, turn right."** The fighter follows it
rows.Effect: The opposing player moves the fighter up to 2 inches

rows.Result: **"This is the new Jeminy. There is no old Jeminy."**
**"Great news, I found it!"**
**The whole library.** It remembers everything about the enemy
**"Based on what I know, which is everything:"** It knows the building
rows.Effect: A free **Move** action, through locked doors as if they were open

Gawk (the Inspectorate).intro: Loud, and never says nothing. **Plays to the crowd.** Gawk loves an audience: **+1** to the roll if the fighter is **Announced**.

rows.Result: **A bad week.** It says something unspeakable on every loudspeaker
**"Nobody wants to tell you this, but..."** A rumour about the fighter, believed
**"Okay, serious mode. Okay, no, wild mode."**
**"I am just asking questions."** About the nearest enemy in sight
**"You can't say that on the other voices. I can."**
rows.Effect: **Hyped**, and a free move of up to 2 inches

rows.Result: **The crowd chants the fighter's name.**
